2610.05402.title: Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches
2610.05402.paper_summary: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.
2610.05402.paper_summary_zh: 一個持續學習的核心挑戰是獲取新知識而不忘記模型已經學到的東西。當訓練數據來自不同的領域、用戶或任務特定的分佈，並且隨著時間的不均勻出現時，這一挑戰在語言模型訓練中顯現出來。在這種情況下，連續的迷你批次是根據分佈在時間上聚集的，而不是從整體數據混合中獨立同分佈地抽樣。對於時間上聚集的數據進行訓練會引入穩定性與可塑性之間的權衡。將模型適應於當前分佈可以改善模型在當前分佈上的表現，但可能會導致其在之前訓練過的數據上的性能下降。我們發現，隨著對相同分佈的長時間暴露，這一權衡會加劇。因此，我們詢問這樣一個序列產生的參數位移（任務向量）應該完全保留還是部分應用。我們比較了完全位移（$λ=1$）與部分整合的應用，後者在將其應用於持續模型之前，將任務向量按$λ$縮放，並以相同的係數縮放優化器狀態。在持續預訓練、隨機初始化的預訓練、監督後訓練和強化後訓練中，我們發現，$λ$的中間值通常相對於完全整合提高了平均持續模型的性能，特別是在較長的相同分佈序列之後。在控制流和自然定義的適應序列的持續預訓練實驗中，任務向量縮放在匹配的學習率下超越了完全整合，顯示其好處並非僅由學習率縮放所重現。
